crossRefs.note: Yahweh makes poor and makes rich. He brings low, he also lifts up.
He raises up the poor out of the dust. He lifts up the needy from the dunghill to make them sit with princes and…
He said, “Naked I came out of my mother’s womb, and naked will I return there. Yahweh gave, and Yahweh has taken away.…
You renew your witnesses against me, and increase your indignation on me. Changes and warfare are with me.
For you write bitter things against me, and make me inherit the iniquities of my youth:
You have shriveled me up. This is a witness against me. My leanness rises up against me. It testifies to my face.
I will come near to you to judgment; and I will be a swift witness against the sorcerers, and against the adulterers…

translations.web: I went out full, and Yahweh has brought me home again empty. Why do you call me Naomi, since Yahweh has testified against me, and the Almighty has afflicted me?”
translations.bsb: I went away full, but the LORD has brought me back empty. Why call me Naomi? After all, the LORD has testified against me, and the Almighty has afflicted me.”
translations.kjv: I went out full, and the LORD hath brought me home again empty: why then call ye me Naomi, seeing the LORD hath testified against me, and the Almighty hath afflicted
translations.asv: I went out full, and Jehovah hath brought me home again empty; why call ye me Naomi, seeing Jehovah hath testified against me, and the Almighty hath afflicted me?
